scope: Privacy-safe recovery contract for Community database and Storage copies. No production resource, paid plan, PITR add-on, or external backup provider is created by this contract.

database.note: If the selected plan/provider retains database recovery copies materially longer than the launch privacy policy expects, D6 must be reviewed and disclosed rather than silently accepted.

storage.note: Supabase Storage S3 versioning is not a recovery mechanism; deleted primary objects must not be assumed recoverable.

recoveryDeletionLedger.purpose: Prevent an older database or Storage recovery copy from re-exposing accounts/content deleted after the backup restore point.
recoveryDeletionLedger.restoreRule: Before any restored Community reads/writes become user-visible, replay all applicable ledger entries against the restored DB and Storage, reapply account/work tombstones, purge owned payload where due, revoke/revalidate restored sessions, and verify no ledger account is publicly discoverable or directly accessible.
recoveryDeletionLedger.failureRule: A restore cannot be promoted to production-visible service if deletion-ledger reconciliation is unavailable or incomplete.
